overview.title: Game Overview
overview.text: This is a text-based game to check how well you know each other and each other's associations. We play in two parts:

phase1.title: Phase 1: Chatting
phase1.text: In the first part, we text similar to how you would in other chatting apps.

phase2.title: Phase 2: Solving
phase2.text: In the second part, we'll try to guess what was the previous word. Each player gets 10 seconds to guess their own previous word text. After 10 seconds, it's a free-for-all and any player can guess!

hints.title: Hints
hints.text: If you don't know the word, hints are available: 1) Word length, 2) Reveal letters, 3) AI context clue. Careful: 3 incorrect guesses exposes the word!

winning.title: Winning
winning.text: The goal is to win by getting the most texts correct in a row.

folder.title: Daily Challenge Folder
folder.text: Welcome to the Daily Chain! Each day brings a new theme and a set of words to solve.

how_to.title: How to Play
how_to.text: Guess the hidden words related to today's theme. The words are chained together by association.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.text: Solve words with fewer hints for more points. Maintain a streak of correct guesses to multiply your score!

winning.title: Winning
winning.text: Complete all words to finish the daily challenge. Come back tomorrow for a new one!

tutorial.step1_desc: Welcome to your daily mental workout! Every day, we release a new chain of meaningful words.
tutorial.step2_desc: Type in your guess here. You have 3 tries per word.
tutorial.step3_desc: Green letters are in the correct position. Orange letters are in the word but wrong spot. You are always solving the message with the colorful border.
tutorial.step4_desc: Stuck? Tap 💡 for a hint or 🏳️ to giveup the current text. You can reveal length, letters, or ask AI.
tutorial.step5_desc: Tap the shuffle icon to rearrange the letters for a fresh perspective.

1.title: 1. Information We Collect
1.content: We collect minimal information necessary to provide the Word Association Game service. This includes your email address (if you provide it for feedback or authentication) and game data generated during your play sessions. We may also collect technical data using third-party tools to ensure reliability.

list.1: Provide and maintain the game service.
list.2: Improve game mechanics and user experience.
list.3: Respond to your feedback and requests.
list.4: Analyze usage patterns and debug issues.

3.title: 3. Data Security
3.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

4.title: 4. Analytics and Third-Party Tools
4.content: We use PostHog and other third-party services for analytics, debugging, and to maintain service reliability. We reserve the right to use collected data for any purpose, including but not limited to marketing and service improvements, without limitation.

5.title: 5. Cookies
5.content: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and game state. We may also use cookies from third-party services (like PostHog) to track usage behavior.
